Around [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] orchestrated an attack on the [[Rift Alliance]]'s [[Attis Station]] on the planet [[Quesh]]. The attack was '''repelled''' by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], assisted by [[Nadia Grell]] of the Rift Alliance.
